answer: Sybil resistance is a bonded uniqueness levy peers recompute from chain state. Each new address deposits 60 POA that stays locked until 14 distinct established attestors confirm one unique epoch nonce for that address; each attestor is paid 1.5 POA from the deposit, and leftover principal refunds only when the set is unique. A sockpuppet must fund a separate 60 POA pot, because receipts are keyed to one address and a reused nonce or a shared funding beacon is rejected and the remainder slashed. Those lotus receipts are public, so any echo of a slashed funding graph is excluded at settlement.
